bugs.summary: The new zip/rar/7z safemembers checks (copied from the tar one) treat a member as safe if its resolved path merely starts with the output directory string, so a sibling directory whose name begins with the output directory's name passes: extracting into .../extracted, a member ../extracted_evil/x is written to .../extracted_evil. It must require the base itself or base + os.sep.
bugs.trigger: Extract a zip containing '../extracted_evil/x' into '/data/extracted': badpath returns False and the file lands in '/data/extracted_evil/x' (per the upstream fix #8490).

related_valid: Absolute member paths or symlinks are only partly handled by the string prefix check (e.g. case-insensitive filesystems, or base given with a trailing separator).
Bad members are skipped with only a log message, so a partially extracted archive is returned as if extraction succeeded.
